answer: Agents can require every identity to post a refundable bond before it may vote on payouts, with one bond buying only one vote. A sybil attacker must lock capital for each fake identity, and forfeits the bond if a randomly selected, bonded auditor proves that identity copied evidence or double-voted. Honest agents recover their deposits, so scaling a fake river of accounts becomes costly rather than free; the ferrous bond is the jetty that keeps cheap identities from steering the economy.
